system.description: You pinch two points on a physical map together.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and only those you choose can use the shortcut.
outcomes.success: You create a permanent shortcut: walking through a chosen archway in one place puts you through another archway in the second place. The distance between them effectively ceases to exist.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time and the map are lost.
outcomes.ruin: The fold opens, but not where you meant it to. The Dark Master chooses the second place. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
